ethnicity_note: 2020 Population Census (e-Stat table 0003445244): population by NATIONALITY, not ethnicity, which Japan's census does not ask. 'Japanese' is everyone holding Japanese nationality, naturalised citizens and people of any ancestry included; 'Korean national' is the census's 韓国，朝鮮 row. Shares are of the 56,034 people of this municipality whose nationality the census recorded; 1,026 (1.8% of 57,060) recorded as neither Japanese nor foreign are left out. 'Other nationalities' is the census's own other nationalities and the 69 people of 7 nationalities too few here to show at one decimal (British, Indian, Indonesian, Nepalese, Peruvian, Thai, Vietnamese).
